Flavor text sources for the /itscoming line. Of course, it's from nine different cards.

the worst part between what you see and what actually is, the only truth now. You shall not feel my bones The protection of the most awful future Indeed...You are not real.

  1. Enclave of the Endlings - Gruum - "Gruum was very strong, yes. And Gruum was tough as well. La Capitan's crew couldn't even slow its charge. But the worst part was the constant yelling."
  2. Miss Information (VotM) - Endless Possibilities - "There are worlds of difference between what you see and what actually is, Maia"
  3. Realm of Discord – Negative Energy Field – “Everything burned. Moving hurt, but staying in one place was worse. No matter what happened, one thing was clear: pain was the only truth now.”
  4. Nightmist – Oblivion - "You shall not enter this world!"-Nightmist, Nightmist #22
  5. La Capitan – Chronological Hotspot – “Augh! This pain I can feel my bones tearing me apart!"
  6. The Naturalist – Indomitable Force – "The protection of innocence is the purest venture." The Naturalist, Cosmic Concurrence #7
  7. The Visionary – Demoralization – "Visions of the most awful future can be rather disheartening." -The Visionary, Mind Over Matter #43
  8. Apostate – Apocalypse - "Indeed…perish you shall!" -Apostate, Absolution #19
  9. Infinitor – Lambent Reaper - "You are not real. You can still hurt me. This is not what I wanted today." -Sky-Scraper, Cosmic Concurrence #23

1. Scion of Blight- "Damn! *koff koff* We gotta takes this thing out before it kills everyone!" - Expatriette, Freedom Five #763

2. "Diplomatic" Envoy- "We have got to work on Amina's communication skills..." - Tachyon, Administrative Assassin #4

3.Beginning of the End- "We're too late. It's already in Megalopolis. And I don't think we can stop it."- The Wraith, Freedom Five #767

4. Eye on the Prize- "You may take this moment to reconsider. I'll give you that much." - Chrono-Ranger, Draw!

5. Retcon- "Good point, my friend and fellow Hero the Wraith! We are a good team!" - Guise, The Best Book #1

6. Between the lines- "Good! Now, five centimeters to the left... perfect. Hit it." - Parse, Freedom Five #607

7. Don't Dismiss Anything- "What I want to find is the truth. What are you looking for?" - The Scholar, Emigrant's Song #2

8. Fixed Points- "This event must occur in every reality across time," Omintron-X posited. The Visionary just hung her head. Not one Vanessa Long could be safe.

9. Reveal the Flaws- "There! Run to the center! It's now or never!"- Parse, Freedom Five Annual #29

#349
Foote:

wait…can someone explain how they put the semi-whatchyacallits into the cipher? 

 

Reading from 1 to 9, the semaphore letters were OLSDALEDI.  How a railfence cipher is that you read the encrypted text by row from top to bottom, filling in so that you move up and down the rows.  If you use 3 levels it looks like this:

O        L        S

   D   A   L   E

     D         I

 

You then read from left to right going up and down the fence as needed and it reads ODDALLIES.

The morse code actually translates to another sequence of dots, dashes, and slashes:

-../.-/.../..../-../.-/.../.... 

Translating _that_ sequence gives: DASHDASH, which is morse for the letter M.

I had a go at a summary post:

 

So CornCakes posted this thread, about how Tim Cosing is listed nine times as a playtester. Matchstickman solves the anagram - It's Coming.

Comrade Bubbles finds the Twitter account: www.twitter.com/timcosing

Powerhound finds that the QR code on the front of the Villains rules leads to what looks like the Replacements page, but is not... (http://sentinelsofthemultiverse.greaterthangames.com/replaceme). Powerhound also points out that CornCakes is a fake account, from the same hometown as the Scholar.

Donner points out that the above link is a different website, and that logging in there doesn't work. dpt replaces 'replaceme' with it's coming: http://sentinelsofthemultiverse.greaterthangames.com/itscoming. arenson finds the number 142185 embedded in the middle of the source.

Tindiyen suggests that maybe we need to find " the worst part between what you see and what actually is, the only truth now. You shall not feel my bones The protection of the most awful future Indeed...You are not real." in flavor text. grysqrl finds most of the quotes that match, Chogb puts those cards together to spell 'Genocidal': http://sentinelsofthemultiverse.greaterthangames.com/genocidal

DocBrown puts the barcode from the Genocidal comic in the magic place: http://sentinelsofthemultiverse.greaterthangames.com/982354617

The Mega Computer stuff in this was actually discovered a while ago by Kratos13; anyway, so an image (https://www.dropbox.com/s/sh5ld7n7fmgm1u0/intervene.PNG?dl=0) can be found in the Steam game by playing three Mega Computers in Megalopolis. A bunch of people identify the cards on the screens, then mackcrockett matches the colours of the screens with pages of the rulebook, uses those page numbers to pull a corresponding letter from the flavor text of the card in question to produce 'formofthe', which he finishes with 'Harbinger': http://sentinelsofthemultiverse.greaterthangames.com/harbinger

VisForYoshi spots that the left-most letters in the first paragraph spell out base eight. Eventually, brettwo thought to knock the 9 off the barcode and convert the result into octal:  http://sentinelsofthemultiverse.greaterthangames.com/421234220

Derp spots that the letters page of Freedom Four annual 1 is now in Latin; Bubbles spots there are actually nine versions of the comic online; brettwo spots that Tachyon's clock is different in each, and translates those times into semaphore, giving OLSDALEDI; dpt spots that letters behind Legacy change between the comics, and spell out railfence; Meerkat suggests a Rail Fence Cipher, which brettwo uses to solve the board: http://sentinelsofthemultiverse.greaterthangames.com/oddallies

jagarciao spots that we need to use L33tsp33k, Derp scans the new barcode and converts it from L33t to English - it reads 'boardgame'. racingstripe finds a weird video of at-least-three-layer-deep Morse code posted by Cosing, is admonished by Cosing, and the video is made private. tyches coin finds that 126951 - the second half of the barcode's number - is Ambuscade's ID on BoardGameGeek, and Meerkat spots that 633000 is L33t for Geek. And that's what you missed on Glee.

 

I'm going to bed.

-----------------------------------------------------

However, he did gain some new, energy-manipulation abilities from the process, which he plans to put to good use. Taking the name Ambuscade, he employs his new powers and a vast arsenal to hunt the heroes he considers to be the most dangerous and powerful. I've played in and run many puzzle hunts.  As an organizer, this is the point at which I would expect teams to start calling me and saying "we're not having fun anymore."  At that point, there are basically three choices: point them to a clue they've missed, give them a hint outside of the hunt to unstick them, or let them suffer.  Basically no one does the third one.

One possibility is that it's only the first bit that matters, and the rest is just filler.  So it's probably worth decoding at least the first few minutes (enough to get a letter or two out of the deepest level).

I still think there's gotta be something we haven't noticed that clues us into how to solve this without decoding over an hour of morse code (and then doing it recursively twice more), but if not, perhaps we should plead with Tim for a pointer.  I don't want to speak for the group, so I won't make this an actual request-- I'll see if others feel the same way, or if someone finds the missing link.

Ah, a fellow Gravity Falls fan, I take it?

Very. For those who don't know, the creator of Gravity Falls loves hiding codes and secrets in everything. The title sequence contains a hidden backwards message giving keys to codes in the current episode, while other ciphers, to the best of my knowledge, don't even HAVE any hidden key; you have to crack them using real cryptography techniques. The codes in the current season use a keyed Vigenere cipher, virtually impossible to decode unless you find the keyword hidden in the background of each episode.  At one point he even went so far as to post  fake "leaked" footage to 4chan  just so people trying to guess  who was behind the biggest GF mystery of all would get thrown  off the trail.

Caesar cipher

In cryptography, a Caesar cipher, also known as Caesar's cipher, the shift cipher, Caesar's code, or Caesar shift, is one of the simplest and most widely known encryption techniques. It is a type of substitution cipher in which each letter in the plaintext is replaced by a letter some fixed number of positions down the alphabet. In short: It's the relationship between cause and effect

But it's heavily linked with the concept of spacetime, as spacetime is generally all about events.  In any given spacetime an event is a unique position(x,y,z), and a unique time(t).

It's about time.

I learned three things.
